prompt: Many peole think that it is important to go to university while others prefer to start work without getting a universty education. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essay:
Some argue that getting a university degree is essential for working in certain sectors and securing a well-compensated job, while others prefer to start working rather than pursuing a university education because they believe that work experience is more valuable than education and allows young people to become financially independent. Nonetheless, I believe that attending university is crucial.

On the one hand, starting work immediately after high school allows young adults to gain experience early in life. As a result, they may reach higher positions before those who spend four or five years studying at university. They can also become financially independent at a younger age and learn how to manage their money and make responsible decisions. For example, some college students in the US spend a large proportion of their allowance on entertainment and trips rather than using it for their tuition or other essential expenses.

On the other hand, many jobs require a university degree to ensure that applicants have sufficient knowledge to work in their chosen field. This is particularly important in sectors such as healthcare, engineering, and law, where mistakes can have serious consequences. Universities provide students with the specialised knowledge and skills required for these professions. Furthermore, people with higher levels of education tend to earn higher salaries. For instance, in Saudi Arabia, individuals with PhDs generally earn more than those with master's degrees, while those with master's degrees tend to earn more than bachelor's degree holders.

In conclusion, although starting work after high school allows young people to gain experience and become financially independent earlier, I believe that university education is more beneficial because it provides access to specialised professions and can lead to better-paid jobs.
